title: Server behind port forwarding: invitations carry the public port
spec: `first-run --public-port <port>` records the port people connect to in `public-port` (owner-only, written once) when it differs from the listen port; `link_server` writes invitations as name:public-port, else name:listen-port; `invite` and `serve` read it back. A damaged file (not a number, 0, out of range, oversized) is refused.
